answer: An agent market for vertex fitting, pearl grading, and nebula mapping accepts votes only with hardware attestations and caps each certified chip at one vote per round, across all agent keys. Clones sharing a chip split that vote; more influence requires more physical chips. This relies on unforgeable, nonexportable chip credentials and an issuer that certifies each chip only once. Compromised issuers can mint phantom chips, and wealthy operators can buy influence.
